description: A ride for women, femme, trans and non-binary Chicagoans. Five to fifteen miles at about 10 mph, with marshals in purple vests blocking intersections. Beginners welcome; nobody gets left behind. Check the calendar for the exact date and start.

name: Half Acre Cycling Wednesday Night for Mortals
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:00 pm, summer into fall while daylight lasts

start_location.name: Winnemac Park parking lot
start_location.address: W Winnemac Ave & N Damen Ave, Chicago, IL 60625

pace: two groups: 16–18 mph and 14–16 mph rolling
description: A no-drop intro to group riding for beginner and intermediate riders. About 20 miles in two pace groups. Ends at Half Acre Brewery on Balmoral. They ask you to RSVP through the form on their site.

name: Major Taylor Cycling Club Chicago Saturday Sunrise Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 5:30 am

start_location.name: La Rabida Children's Hospital parking lot

founded_note: Club founded 2008, per majortaylorchicago.com. The ride's own start year is not stated.
description: Saturday sunrise ride from the lakefront at La Rabida in South Shore. A bit quicker than the weekday Sunrise ride. The club's page lists 5:30 am; an older community listing said 6:00, so check the calendar.

name: Major Taylor Cycling Club Chicago Sunrise Ride
schedule: Monday through Friday, 5:30 am
founded_note: Club founded 2008, per majortaylorchicago.com. The ride's own start year is not stated.
description: Weekday sunrise ride from Bronzeville on the South Side. Easy pace, 20–25 miles, done by 7:30. Hosted by Chicago's Major Taylor club, a Black-led club open to all riders.

name: Southside Critical Mass
schedule: First Friday of every month, 6:15 pm, April–November
description: The South Side's own Critical Mass, on the first Friday instead of the last. Listed in the Chicago Group Rides directory; check the Facebook page for each month's start point.

name: Spidermonkey Saturday Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 8:00 am
description: Club ride from Hexe Coffee to Highland Park and back, with optional extensions. The club calls it a good first group ride and makes sure new riders get to Highland Park. Read the group ride rules on their site first. Check the club calendar before you show up.

name: Streets Calling Bike Club Night Ride
schedule: Thursdays, 8:00 pm, starting in May. Some weeks move to Wednesday. Start point is posted on Instagram.
pace: open to all paces, quick at the front
founded_note: Formed in 2020 and led by Ronald King, Daphnay Sagaille and Diamond Allen, per Streetsblog Chicago (Aug 2020).
description: A Black-owned nonprofit bike club that rides at night through the city and stops at minority-owned businesses. Big, social crowd. About 10 miles. The meetup spot changes, so check their Instagram the week of.

name: Turin Tubular Tuesday Trot
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00 pm rollout
description: Shop ride from Turin in Ravenswood to the northern suburbs and back. No-drop at 16–19 mph. The shop also hosts the Saturday 7:00 am Cowbell x Turin ride, 45 miles at the same pace, open to all.

name: Windy City Cycling Club Casual Saturday
schedule: Every Saturday, 9:00 am

start_location.name: Kwa-Ma-Rolas totem pole, Addison St & Lakefront Trail
start_location.address: W Addison St & Lakefront Trail, Chicago, IL 60613

pace: easy 10–12 mph and moderate 13–14 mph groups
description: Chicago's LGBTQA+ cycling club. The Saturday ride is the easy one: about 26 miles along the lakefront at 10–14 mph. Allies welcome. RSVP on Meetup.

name: Windy City Cycling Club Sunday Morning Ride
schedule: Every Sunday, 8:00 am

start_location.name: Foster Ave & Lakefront Trail
start_location.address: W Foster Ave & Lakefront Trail, Chicago, IL 60640

pace: cruising 15–17 mph and fast 18+ mph groups
description: The longer, faster ride from Chicago's LGBTQA+ cycling club. Leaves Foster Beach and heads up the North Shore toward Fort Sheridan. Two pace groups. RSVP on Meetup.

name: xXx Racing Saturday Team Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 7:00 am Apr–Nov, 8:00 am Dec–Mar. Second pickup in Rogers Park 30 minutes later.

start_location.name: Wicker Park, SE corner of Damen Ave & N Wicker Park Ave
start_location.address: N Damen Ave & N Wicker Park Ave, Chicago, IL 60622

pace: 18–20 mph to Highland Park, faster extensions after
description: The team's open Saturday ride up the North Shore to Highland Park. No-drop on the way out at 18–20 mph. After Highland Park it splits and the extensions are drop rides. You don't have to be on the team. Helmets, working brakes, no aero bars.

name: Illinois Valley Wheelm'n Tuesday Evening Ride
schedule: Tuesdays, 6:00 pm in summer (5:30 pm in April, early May and after Labor Day), April to early October
description: The Peoria area club's Tuesday night road ride, just north of Peoria in Dunlap. Mileage is 20 to 30 as daylight allows. The group averages about 17 mph and regroups so nobody is left behind. Start time shifts to 5:30 pm in the shoulder months.

name: Major Taylor Cycling Club Chicago Monday Night Malarkey
schedule: Every Monday, 6:00 pm
founded_note: Club founded 2008, per majortaylorchicago.com. The ride's own start year is not stated.
description: Monday evening ride in the south suburbs. Several pace groups from 12 to 17 mph, so newer riders have a place. Hosted by Chicago's Major Taylor club.

name: McLean County Wheelers Weekend Show & Go
schedule: Saturday and Sunday mornings, April through October. Start time changes by month (7:00 am in July to 11:00 am in April and October)
description: The Bloomington-Normal club's weekend no-drop ride. It leaves from the Brander Shelter at Underwood Park on the Constitution Trail. The focus is safe, social riding, not racing. Some weekends have a food stop as the destination. The club also runs evening ice cream rides and spring training rides for new riders.

name: Oak Park Cycle Club Monday Social Ride
schedule: Mondays in season. Start time shifts with daylight (5:00 pm in mid-September 2026).

start_location.name: NW corner of East Ave & Lake St, by the OPRF High School stadium
start_location.address: East Ave & Lake St, Oak Park, IL 60302

pace: 12–15 mph, may split into slower and faster groups
description: About 20 miles at a talking pace. The club says it doesn't leave riders behind and welcomes beginners and people coming back to riding. Lights required on evening rides. The club also runs Tuesday and Thursday training rides from the same corner.

name: Park Ridge Cycling Club Monday Night Social Ride
schedule: Mondays, 6:15 pm, Memorial Day through Labor Day

start_location.name: Prospect Park
start_location.address: 733 N Prospect Ave, Park Ridge, IL 60068

pace: two groups, capped at 14 mph and 18 mph
description: The club's summer social ride and the one they point newcomers to. Two speeds, 12 or 16 miles. Ends at Beer on the Wall on Main Street. Bring lights late in the season.

name: Blackhawk Saturday NE Ride
schedule: Saturdays, 9:00 am (8:00 am June through August), March to November
pace: leisure and moderate groups (10–17 mph), no one left behind
description: A Saturday morning road ride from Guilford High School with breakfast in Belvidere. There are leisure and moderate groups and two distances. No one is left behind. The club asks riders to check its event calendar for current details.

name: Springfield Bicycle Club Group Rides
schedule: Group rides most days of the week, April through October. See the club's Google calendar
pace: Pace groups from EZ (under 10 mph, no-drop) to A (18–20+ mph)
description: A 380-member club in central Illinois with rides almost every day in season. Rides are sorted by pace, from EZ social rides where nobody is dropped up to fast A rides. D rides are for novices and have a sweep. There are gravel and mountain bike rides too. Times and start points are on the club's Google calendar.

name: Major Taylor Cycling Club Chicago Big Ring
schedule: Tuesdays through the season, 6:00 pm sharp to 7:30 pm

start_location.name: Bartel Grasslands
start_location.address: Central Ave & Flossmoor Rd, Tinley Park, IL 60477

pace: A group 20+ mph, B group 17–18 mph
description: MTC3's signature Tuesday paceline ride in the south suburbs. A group drops, B group holds together if you keep the pace. The club, named for the first Black world cycling champion, runs rides nearly every day of the week from the South Side and suburbs, including a weekday Sunrise ride and a slower Tuesday Slow Your Roll.

name: Wednesday World pb Bloomington Bicycles
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:00 pm

start_location.name: E Kirkwood Ave & S Indiana Ave
start_location.address: E Kirkwood Ave & S Indiana Ave, Bloomington, IN 47405

description: Bloomington's fast Wednesday ride, with a rotation of five routes called out on the day. Little 500 riders and local strong riders show up. Not a beginner ride.

name: 3RVS Monday Morning Meandering and Musings
schedule: Every Monday, 10:00 am, from early May; start varies (see club calendar)
founded_note: Club founded 1969, per its About page
description: A women-only slow ride on city streets and trails with a mid-ride refreshment stop. Made for people fairly new to the bike or coming back after a long time off.

name: 3RVS Wednesday D Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:15 pm, from early May

start_location.name: Alternates between Huntertown Elementary and Arcola Elementary (check the club calendar)

pace: D pace, 14–15 mph, slower if the group wants
founded_note: Club founded 1969, per its About page
description: Built for riders of different skill levels and welcoming to people newer to group riding. Fifteen to twenty-five miles at an easy D pace, dialed back when needed.

name: BikeParty Indianapolis
schedule: Second Friday of the month, rolls 7:30 pm. Start location rotates.
description: Monthly Friday night party ride. The start moves around the city each month. Listed by Central Indiana Cycling as a partner ride.

name: Riverside Riders
schedule: Thursdays and Sundays, 5:30 pm, starting in April
description: A neighborhood ride out of Riverside Park, twice a week. Listed by Central Indiana Cycling as a partner ride. 8 to 15 miles.

name: The Bike Line Tuesday & Thursday Road Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday and Thursday, 7:00 pm
pace: fast group ~23 mph, slower group ~18 mph
description: A marked ~22 mile road route from the Broad Ripple shop. Not a no-drop ride, but it usually splits into a fast group and a more leisurely one.

name: Weekly Near Eastside Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:00 pm sharp (2026 season started March 11)
description: A short, slow neighborhood ride from Centerpoint Brewing. Run by Central Indiana Cycling, the group formed when CIBA and Bike Indianapolis merged in 2025. Leaves on time.

name: Bikes and Brews (formerly the Rollout)
schedule: Every Thursday, May–August; arrive 6:15 pm, roll 6:30 pm sharp

start_location.name: The old 7-11
start_location.address: 501 E LaSalle Ave, South Bend, IN 46617

pace: social ride, MTB ride and a faster road ride each week
description: South Bend's Thursday night ride series with three options: a social ride, a mountain bike ride and a faster road ride. Everyone meets up at The Lauber afterward.

name: MBA Monday Leisure Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 6:00 pm, April–September and beyond if weather allows
description: A hosted leisure ride from Pinhook Park. Ten to seventeen miles at 10–13 mph, and the group always stays together. Distance grows through the season.

name: Babes on Bikes Weekly Ride
schedule: Wednesdays, around 6:00 pm

start_location.name: 700 block of Commercial St, downtown Emporia

description: A weekly women's ride in the home town of Unbound Gravel. Visit Emporia points riders to the group's Facebook page for updates. The visitor guide lists it on Wednesdays around 6 pm from the 700 block of Commercial Street. Confirm on Facebook before you show up.

name: The Sunday Chug
schedule: Sundays, usually 8:30 am
pace: no riders left behind before the first pit stop
description: A weekly gravel ride out of Sunflower in downtown Lawrence. It usually rolls at 8:30, with an early or late option depending on season and weather. Nobody gets left before the first pit stop, where the shop provides water, coffee and gels. There's a free bike wash at the shop after. Routes are on the Strava club.

name: Velas Thursday Women's Ride
schedule: Thursdays, 6:00 pm
pace: usually two distance options, all skill levels
description: A women's ride that launches from Sunflower Outdoor & Bike on Thursday evenings. There are usually two distance options. All skill levels are welcome. Velas posts each week's details on Instagram.

name: BRBC Monday Social Ride
schedule: Every Monday, gather 6:15 pm, roll 6:30 pm, March–September
cost: free to try, no membership required
description: A relaxed 15-mile loop through the neighborhoods around Mission Farms, good for recovery days and for beginners. A sweep rider holds 12 mph so nobody is left. The club's Saturday rides are faster: a 7:15 am coffee ride and a 9 am 40-mile drop ride with regroups.

name: Final Fridays (Critical Mass)
schedule: Last Friday of every month, 7:00 pm
description: A slow 2.5-mile group ride through downtown Manhattan and Aggieville on the last Friday of each month. It starts at the courthouse on Poyntz. Front and rear lights and a helmet are required. People usually get pizza and drinks after.

name: KVBC Dover Dogs
schedule: Every Thursday, 6:00 pm, spring through fall

start_location.name: Western Hills Church, 29th & Auburn Rd
start_location.address: SW 29th St & SW Auburn Rd, Topeka, KS 66614

pace: mixed group that splits by speed and regroups in Dover
description: A 20-mile out-and-back to the town of Dover on the west edge of Topeka. The group splits by speed and everyone regroups in Dover. All welcome. Bring lights in case the sun gets low.

name: KVBC Wednesday Slow Roll
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:10 pm, spring through fall (starts early May)

start_location.name: Washburn University parking lot, SW 20th & MacVicar
start_location.address: SW 20th St & SW MacVicar Ave, Topeka, KS 66604

description: A 15-mile round trip on streets and trails for beginner and intermediate riders. E-bikes welcome. Often stops for ice cream near the end. Helmets and a good attitude required. Check the club's calendar or Facebook for start and end dates.

name: Bicycle Pedaler Monday Gravel Ride
schedule: Every Monday night, April through October
description: A no-drop gravel ride run by the Bicycle Pedaler shop. It goes 20 to 25 miles every Monday night in season. Routes, start points and cancellations go up on the shop's Facebook and Instagram. In winter the shop moves the Monday ride to Zwift.

name: KSS Thursday Night MTB Ride
schedule: Every Thursday night, show and go from 5:30 to 9:30 pm
description: The Kansas Singletrack Society's weekly mountain bike night. It is show and go, so people roll out when they arrive. Bring a drink and something to grill or share after the ride. The trail location is posted in the KSS Facebook group.

name: BikeWalkBG Weekly Community Women's Bike Ride
schedule: Mondays, 5:30–7:30 pm, in season

start_location.name: Warren County Bike Safety Park at the Fringe

host.name: BikeWalkBG / City-County Planning Commission of Warren County

description: A free women's community ride organized by the county's BikeWalkBG program from the downtown bike safety park. Family rides and a monthly seniors ride run from the same spot.

name: RideTheCov Wednesday Series
schedule: 2nd and 4th Wednesdays, 6:00 pm, late March through October
description: Short, easy rides through the river cities to get people on bikes. A quick safety check and tire pump before rolling. Group riding basics explained at the start. Helmets suggested.

name: First Friday Social Ride
schedule: First Friday of the month, 6:00 pm
description: A family-friendly five-to-eight mile ride around downtown Lexington that ends at a local brewery. Casual pace, everyone welcome.

name: Pedal Power x Country Boy Community Bike Ride
schedule: 2nd and 4th Wednesdays; meet 6:15 pm, roll 6:30 pm
description: A casual loop around town from Country Boy Brewing, then back for the shop's happy hour. Nobody gets left behind. Cancelled if it rains.

name: Monnik Monday Recovery Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 6:15 pm sharp, year-round
founded_note: See Ridenfaden Wednesday
description: A really slow recovery ride from Monnik in Schnitzelburg. Ten to fifteen miles at ten to fifteen mph, then a discounted pint back at the brewery.

name: Ridenfaden Wednesday
schedule: Every Wednesday, year-round; no-drop group 6:00 pm, fast ride 6:30 pm
pace: no-drop group and a fast group
founded_note: Two friends' post-ride beers at Seidenfaden's in 2009 grew into the group; the name Ridenfaden dates to 2015, per the About page
description: A year-round Wednesday ride out of a Germantown bar, with a no-drop group at 6 and a fast ride at 6:30. Everyone ends up back at Seidenfaden's by 8. Some race, some slow roll, all fine.

name: The Outsiders Wednesday Social Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday; meet 6:00 pm, roll 6:45 pm
founded_note: Founded 2023 by Jef and Brendan, per the club's About page
description: Louisville's largest social ride. Every rider, every bike, no one left behind. Ten to twenty miles at a conversational pace with rotating stops around the city.

name: Downtown East Social Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 6:00 pm (weather permitting)

start_location.name: Outside City Roots at Electric Depot

founded_note: Started 2019 by Samantha Morgan, per 225 Magazine
description: A Monday evening ride through Downtown East that tells the neighborhood's history as it goes. Seven to 10 miles at the pace of the slowest rider. Free and open to everyone; lights are required by state law and the group hands out free ones.

name: Geaux Ride Thursday Night Community Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, meet 7:30 pm, roll 7:45 pm, back by 9:30 pm
cost: free with your own bike; rentals available
description: A free Thursday night cruise through downtown Baton Rouge with lights and music. Bring your own bike or rent one from Geaux Ride. Family friendly. Street parking or the garage at 3rd and Main.

name: Bike Lafayette Saturday Community Ride
schedule: Second and last Saturday of each month; details on Facebook
founded_note: Bike Lafayette founded 2007, per The Advocate; the ride's own start date is not stated
description: Twice a month the advocacy nonprofit Bike Lafayette hosts a community ride around town. Start point and time are posted on the Bike Lafayette Facebook page. The same page lists partner rides like Lafayette Critical Mass and Krewe de Velo.

name: Get Up N Ride Tuesday Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 8:00 pm

start_location.name: The Art Garage (meet-up changes from time to time; check the group's social pages)
start_location.address: 2231 St Claude Ave, New Orleans, LA

founded_note: Riding every Tuesday since October 2015, per Momentum Mag's coverage of New Orleans social rides
description: A three-hour Tuesday social ride through New Orleans with music and stops. Now also a bike lifestyle brand that runs tours and rentals. Check Instagram for the week's start.

name: NOLA Social Ride Happy Thursday
schedule: Every Thursday, 7:00 pm meet, ride leaves 8:00 pm. Start rotates by week of the month (Uptown, Mid-City and more)
founded_note: Helping people discover fun on bikes since 2010, per the group's Facebook page
description: A slow cruise through a different part of New Orleans every Thursday, ending at a local bar. Bring speakers, lights and a smile; costumes are common. The website was down when checked, so use the Facebook group for the weekly start spot.

name: NOLA Social Ride Thursday Night Ride
schedule: Every Thursday night; start posted weekly on Facebook
founded_note: Riding since 2010, per the group's Facebook page description in search results
description: New Orleans' long-running Thursday night social ride. Themed routes, a slow pace, and a bar or park at the end. The start point changes, so check the Facebook page that week.

name: SB Rides LED Night Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday; meet 8:00 pm, ride 8:30 pm (plus occasional themed Friday/Saturday night rides)

start_location.name: Corner of Crockett St & Commerce St, downtown Shreveport (meet-up subject to change)
start_location.address: Crockett St & Commerce St, Shreveport, LA 71101

founded_note: Started 2019 by Greg Powell, per Visit Shreveport-Bossier
cost: tickets from $10; LED bike rental available
description: A two-hour night cruise on LED-lit beach cruisers through downtown Shreveport with a couple of bar stops. Built for people who do not own a bike or have not ridden in years. Ages 21 and up. Dates are posted a few weeks at a time.

name: Shreveport Bicycle Club Saturday Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 7:30 am; also Tuesday and Thursday rides
description: The local road club's Saturday ride from a church lot in southeast Shreveport. The club also rides Tuesdays and Thursdays. Check the club Facebook page for the week's route and any changes.

name: Boston Bike Party
schedule: Second Friday of every month, 7:00 pm
founded_note: Brought to Boston in 2013 by Elodie Garcia after riding with DC Bike Party, per the About Us page
description: A monthly social group ride at a casual pace, volunteer-run and free. Around a thousand riders on a good night. Meets at Copley Square unless a post says otherwise. All ages, all bikes.

name: Landry's Boston Slow Roll Social Ride
schedule: Mondays, 6:00 pm, spring through mid-September (2026 season ended 9/14)
description: A ten-mile Monday evening social ride with a snack stop in the middle. Built for hybrid bikes and people who don't own spandex. Arrive fifteen minutes early for the safety talk; flashing lights required. Seasonal; the 2026 run ended September 14.

name: Sea Sports Coffee Cruise
schedule: Every Saturday, 7:30 am
description: A year-round Saturday road ride from the shop in Hyannis. No-drop at 16 to 18 mph. In summer the shop also runs a Monday easy mountain bike ride and alternating Tuesday gravel and Wednesday road rides. A yearly waiver and a helmet are required.

name: Conte's Sunday Ride p/b B2C2
schedule: Every Sunday, 9:00 am sharp
description: One ride, four groups. The S group is a team time trial that drops; A and B are no-drop within their pace; C is strictly no-drop and meant for people new to group riding. Riders from the south can join the team rolling from the Uncle Sam statue in Arlington at 8:30. Coffee at the shop after.

name: The Judy Jam
schedule: Mondays, 5:30 pm, mid-April to mid-September
description: Riverside's Monday night no-drop ride with a sweeper, led by Judy. Two groups, sixteen to twenty-four miles on the North Shore. The shop also runs a faster Tuesday ride, a Wednesday gravel ride and a Thursday MTB ride out of Manchester-by-the-Sea. Details come by weekly email.

name: Northampton Cycling Club Wednesday A/B Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 5:30 pm, April–September
cost: free for two trial rides, then club membership
description: The club's long-running Wednesday ride rolls out of downtown, up Route 9 and over to Hatfield at a conversational pace, then the A group goes. Expect real climbing, 2,000 to 6,000 feet. Routes change weekly and are posted for GPS. Newcomers are steered to the Monday introductory ride first.

name: Seven Hills Wheelmen Tuesday Night Ride
schedule: Tuesdays, 5:30 pm (moves to 5:30 pm from Sept 22 as daylight shortens), late April onward
description: A 23-mile Tuesday evening loop through the hills west of Worcester, from the school lot in Paxton. Moderate pace. The Wheelmen keep a public list of a dozen other recurring rides across central Massachusetts and the Quiet Corner of Connecticut.

name: GBNEMBA Tuesday Western Greenway Social Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00–8:00 pm
description: A weekly social trail ride on the Western Greenway, Beaver Brook and Lone Tree Hill network, leaving from a brewery. Several paces, no-drop. The chapter also runs a Monday beginner ride and a Tuesday women and gender-expansive ride with Hustle Hive; check the chapter page for those.

name: Landry's Needham Women's/Non-Binary MTB Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, meet 5:45 pm, roll 6:00 pm, weather permitting

start_location.name: Hale Reservation, Cat Rock Field lot

host.name: Landry's Bicycles with SE MA NEMBA

description: A weekly trail ride for women and gender-expansive riders at Hale, run by Landry's Needham with SE MA NEMBA. Intermediate level: rocks, roots, ninety minutes of steady riding with regroups. Supportive and no-drop. Location can change; check the page weekly.

name: Sunday No-Drop Ride (ABRT Cycling)
schedule: Sundays; 8:00 am summer, 9:00 am spring/fall, 10:00 am winter

start_location.name: Prince George St at USNA Barry Gate

description: A team-hosted no-drop road ride from downtown Annapolis with many regroup points. Thirty-five to forty-five miles at 16 to 18 mph. Start time moves with the season. The team's Saturday ride from Davidsonville is faster and only the B group waits.

name: Baltimore Bike Party
schedule: Last Friday of every month, gather 6:30 pm, roll 7:00 pm
description: A monthly mass slow roll through Baltimore. All ages, all bikes, no registration. The route changes every month and is posted a day or two before. Rides under West Coast rules, stopping at red lights, and ends around 9 at an after-party.

name: Taco Tuesday Ride
schedule: Tuesdays; meet spot and time posted in the Facebook group each week
description: A weekly Tuesday social ride in Baltimore that ends at a taco spot. The group polls its Facebook members on where to eat, then rides there. Listed on Bikemore's community ride roundup. Check the group for that week's start.

name: Sunday Shop Ride (Bethesda Bike & Ski)
schedule: Sundays, meet 8:45 am, roll 9:00 am
description: A 28-mile loop from the shop at a steady 15 mph with a coffee stop at Colada's in Cabin John. Rides start and end at the shop. Email the shop to get added to the WhatsApp group.

name: Thursday Parvilla Shop Ride
schedule: Thursdays, 5:30 pm, April to mid-October
pace: recovery pace; A/B split after 5 miles
description: A 23-mile evening shop ride south of Annapolis, billed as recovery and enjoyment rather than training. The group splits into A and B after the first five miles. Runs spring through mid-October.

name: Sunday Ride from Monocacy Middle School (Frederick Pedalers)
schedule: Sundays, 9:30 am
description: A no-cue-sheet ride that wanders the west side of Route 15, a slightly different way each week. The club calls itself friendly and it is club policy not to drop a rider. Start time shifts with the season; check the ride calendar.

name: Goon Ride
schedule: Tuesdays and Thursdays, 6:30 pm, March–September
description: One of the hardest and fastest drop rides in the DC area, per DC Paceline. Twice a week from Veirs Mill Park during daylight-savings months. Not a beginner ride. Bring lights and know the route.

name: Slipping Gears Saturday Morning Road Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 8:00 am, spring through fall
description: An easy Saturday road ride from the shop, back by about 10. Beginners are welcome. The shop also leads a Tuesday evening mountain bike ride at Bangor City Forest with A and B groups, and a faster Thursday evening road ride. Watch the shop's Facebook for cancellations.

name: Rose Bike Women's MTB Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 5:00 pm (2026 season)

start_location.name: Rose Bike (sometimes meets at other local trails)

description: A Wednesday women's mountain bike ride from the shop in downtown Orono. All Rose Bike rides are no-drop. The shop also runs a Monday MTB ride, a Tuesday beginner MTB ride from Old Town Elementary, a mellow Tuesday mixed-surface ride and a Saturday MTB ride. Helmet and yearly waiver required.

name: CycleMania Thursday Night Mountain Bike Ride
schedule: Thursdays, 6:00 pm
description: An all-inclusive Thursday night ride on Portland's in-town trails, leaving from the shop. Bring a mountain bike; that's the only requirement. Call the shop with questions.

name: Gorham Bike & Ski Friday Morning Coffee Shop Road Ride
schedule: Fridays, 8:00 am, first Friday in May through last Friday in November
pace: talking pace out, can get spirited on the way back
description: A Friday morning ride at talking pace up to Yarmouth for coffee and something to eat, then back to Portland. Road bikes only. Has been known to keep going through winter when the roads allow.

name: Mellow Monday Ride
schedule: 2nd and 4th Mondays; meet 6:00 pm, roll 6:10 pm, back by ~7:20
description: A short ride for new riders and people getting back on a bike. Back Cove to Payson Park, snacks, a few short skills workshops, then back. Gear Hub is Portland's nonprofit community bike shop. Bring lights and a helmet.

name: Portland Gear Hub Thursday Group Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, 6:00 pm; four rotating routes by week of the month
description: A social-pace road ride north or south of the peninsula with ice cream or beach stops. Four routes rotate by week: Higgins Beach, Falmouth, Kettle Cove, Tuttle Loop. There is no sweep, so know the route and be able to fix a flat. Ride whatever bike you have.

name: Queers in Gear Saturday Ride
schedule: Saturdays at 4:00 pm, weather permitting (2026 season announced June 2026)
description: A queer cycling group based in Portland and Lewiston-Auburn, Maine. The Portland ride meets at the Gear Hub, a nonprofit community bike shop, for a 10 to 12 mile social loop. No-drop, all levels, lights required.

name: Gorham Bike & Ski Saco Tuesday Night Gravel Ride
schedule: Tuesdays, 6:00 pm, mid-April until the light runs out
description: A moderate-pace mixed-surface ride from the Saco shop: pavement, dirt, and a few singletrack sections thrown in. Gravel bikes suggested, anything welcome. The same shop runs a Wednesday no-drop ride from Clifford Park in Biddeford.

name: Portland Velo Club Wednesday Night Ride
schedule: Wednesdays, 5:30 pm

start_location.name: South Portland High School parking lot

pace: A 20–26 mph no waiting; B group behind
description: Maine's biggest club's Wednesday hammer ride. The A group leaves at 5:30 and does not wait; if you get dropped, fall in with the B group. Plan on a hard night either way, with a sprint at the end for those who want it.

name: Gorham Bike & Ski Waterville Wednesday Night Mountain Bike Ride
schedule: Wednesdays, 6:00 pm
description: A no-drop trail ride from the Waterville shop, usually at Quarry Road or Inland Pine Ridge. Twelve to fifteen miles at a moderate pace; if the group splits, it waits. The shop also runs a Thursday 5 pm road ride from the same spot.

name: AAVC Monday Social Road Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 6:00 pm, mid-March through late October
cost: free, club waiver required (non-members arrive 10 min early)
description: A no-drop, lycra-optional road ride focused on learning safe group riding. About 20 miles, usually out to Dexter and back with a stop. Open to non-members who sign the waiver.

name: Nacho Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:00 pm, April–October
pace: slow, then fast for the last 15 km, then nachos
description: Out-and-back on one straight road from Homes Brewery. Most of it is chill; the last stretch home gets fast. Ends with nachos. Listed as no-drop style by Wheels in Motion.

name: Cruise: Detroit
schedule: Roughly monthly; dates posted on Instagram and Facebook
description: Queers on bikes. A casual, monthly-ish group ride in and around Detroit, with allies welcome. Routes and meet points change; follow the Instagram for the next one.

name: Metropolis Cycles Monday Night Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 7:00 pm
description: A Monday night no-drop ride from the Corktown bike shop. About two and a half hours at 12–15 mph. Details come from BridgeDetroit's ride guide (updated April 2024), so check the ride's Facebook group before you go.

name: People for Palmer Park Thursday Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, May 7–Oct 29, 2026; meet 6:00 pm, roll 6:30 pm sharp
description: A one-hour loop out of Palmer Park through the Apartment District, Golf Club neighborhood, Ferndale, New Center and Boston Edison. Led by a park volunteer. Join for part or all of it.

name: Slow Roll Detroit Thursday Night Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, May through September. Meet 5:00 pm, roll out 6:30 pm, back by 8:30 pm
founded_note: Slow Roll started in Detroit in 2010 and relaunched in 2026 as a smaller Thursday ride, per the RiDetroit page and Momentum Mag (Mar 2026)
description: The ride that started the Slow Roll movement, back on the streets in 2026 after a pause. Now a Thursday ride of 8 to 12 miles at an easy pace, with a set two-hour window. All bikes and all riders. Register once per season and check the Facebook group for the weekly start point.

name: Village Bike & Fitness Tuesday Night Road Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 7:00 pm, weather permitting

start_location.name: Riverside Park boat launch (Monroe & Knapp)
start_location.address: Monroe Ave NE & Knapp St NE, Grand Rapids, MI 49505

description: A shop-led road ride on rolling roads toward Rockford and Cannonsburg and around downtown. It teaches group skills like calling hazards and riding a paceline. Helmets required, lights recommended.

name: Wednesday Evening Rides
schedule: Every Wednesday; meet 7:45 pm, depart 8:00 pm sharp

start_location.name: Veterans Memorial Park
start_location.address: 101 Fulton St E, Grand Rapids, MI 49503

description: A casual 10–12 mile roll through Grand Rapids streets for exploring, socializing and being seen on bikes. Usually ends with a drink at a bar. Bring a working bike, helmet and lights.

name: KBC Monday Night Ride
schedule: Every Monday, March 10–Oct 31; 6:00 pm (5:30 pm in March and October)
pace: up to eight groups, 12–13 mph through 19–21 mph
description: The club's main weeknight ride, with up to eight pace groups from a 12–13 mph no-drop learner ride to a fast Lawton loop. Pick your group in the parking lot. Helmets required.

name: KBC Sunday LGBTQIA+ Allies Ride
schedule: Every Sunday, May–September; arrive 15–20 min early, roll 10:00 am; start rotates by week of month

start_location.name: Rotates: 1st Sun Celery Flats (7328 Garden Ln, Portage); 2nd Sun Texas Drive Park (6603 Texas Dr, Kalamazoo); 3rd Sun Oshtemo Grange Hall (3234 N 3rd St); 4th Sun Kindleberger Park (Parchment)

description: A no-drop club ride for LGBTQIA+ riders and allies. All abilities welcome. Starts rotate between four parks through the month. Helmets required, lights encouraged.

name: Lansing Bike Party
schedule: Every Friday; meet 6:00 pm, roll 6:30 pm (earlier in fall as days shorten)
founded_note: Started spring 2009 at Beaumont Tower on the MSU campus, per the MSU Bikes blog and East Lansing Info
description: The Lansing area's biggest weekly social ride. A laid-back cruise around the region with a rest stop or two and a stop for food and drinks, then a ride back. Music and bells are common. Bring lights.

name: Quick Stop Tuesday Night Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:30 pm
description: A moderate mountain bike ride on mostly blue-square trails with a few black diamonds. Early spring and late fall it turns into a gravel ride, and sometimes a klunker ride. Check the shop or its Facebook page.

name: PEDAL Tuesday Queer Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00 pm, through mid-September
description: A social, casual ride on paved trails hosted by the PEDAL bike shop. Everyone welcome, all bikes including e-bikes. Party pace, 8 to 12 miles. Last ride of 2026 was September 15.

name: NMMBA Community Group Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 6:30 pm, May through about the end of October
description: The trail association's own Monday ride on the VASA singletrack. Lots of regroup stops, so nobody rides alone. A good first group ride on dirt.

name: Wildcard Wednesday Night Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, early spring to late fall, 6:00 pm rollout

host.name: Wildcard Cycleworks / Universal Racing / Shorts Brewing

description: The Traverse City mountain bike shop ride. Multiple groups by speed, including a slow group for new riders. Snacks and drinks at the trailhead afterward.

name: Ski Hut Wednesday Night Social Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, meet 5:45 pm, roll 6:00 pm (summer)

start_location.name: Location announced weekly by email and social media

description: A beginner-friendly evening ride of about 20 miles put on by the Ski Hut. The start moves around Duluth; the shop posts each week's location. Runs through the summer.

name: Angry Catfish Thursday FTW Social Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, meet 6:00 pm, roll 6:30 pm
description: A weekly ride for femme, trans and women riders only. About 15 miles at a talking pace, route varies. Starts and ends at the shop's coffee bar. Ride details go out on the shop's Discord and Instagram.

name: Bonesaw Cycling Collective Summer Tuesday Ride
schedule: Last Tuesday of the month, April–September, meet 6:45 pm, roll 7:00 pm

start_location.name: Cepro Site / Parque Monarca (Midtown Greenway at 10th Ave S)

description: A monthly summer social ride from the Greenway to the Sabo Bridge. 12 to 15 miles at 10–12 mph with a mid-ride stop. Guest groups like Biking with Baddies and the bike polo club help lead. Bring lights and a lock.

name: Fixie Friday
schedule: Fridays, meet 6:45 pm, roll 7:00 pm
description: Fixed gear only. Meets at Behind Bars in Northeast and does a different thing each week: lake laps, river laps, parking-ramp crits, a costume night. Helmet and lights. Each week's route goes up on the shop's Instagram.

name: Freewheel MPLS Wednesday Night Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:00 pm (spring–September)
description: A weekly road ride out of the Freewheel shop near the U of M. About 25 miles at 15–17 mph. Road or gravel bike, helmet and light. Sign the waiver through the Strava club event; weather cancellations post there too. The 2026 series ends September 16.

name: Joyful Riders Club Monthly Ride at Fulton
schedule: Second Thursday of every month, 6:00 pm
description: A slow, family-friendly party ride that starts and ends at the Fulton taproom in the North Loop. About an hour and a half of riding with music. The club is based in Minneapolis and Saint Paul and also runs summer DJ rides.

name: Joyful Riders DJ Dance Ride at Perennial Cycle
schedule: Monthly Saturday in summer, 7:00 pm (2026 dates included Jun 6 and Sep 12)

host.name: The Joyful Riders Club with Perennial Cycle

description: A DJ on a bike trailer leads a slow ride through Minneapolis with stops for dancing. Part of the Summer DJ Dance Ride Series from Perennial Cycle and the Joyful Riders Club. Party pace, nobody left behind.

name: Sociable Cider x Recovery Bike Shop Wednesday Social Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:00 pm (year-round)
description: A slow, meandering loop through Northeast that starts and ends at the cider taproom. Recovery Bike Shop sends mechanical support. Riders get a pint of cider at the finish. Cancellations for weather or holidays get posted on the shop's Instagram.

name: Utepils Cycling Sunday Road and MTB Rides
schedule: Every Sunday, meet 9:45 am, roll 10:00 am
pace: Road groups: Rec 11–13 mph, Sport Ultra Lite 15–17, Sport Lite 17–19, Sport 19–21; three MTB groups on the Wirth trails
description: Sunday morning rides from the brewery next to Theodore Wirth Park. Four road pace groups from 11 mph up, plus three mountain bike groups when the trails are dry. Everyone hangs out on the patio afterward. Helmets required.

name: Cycle Unmapped Thursday Rides
schedule: Every Thursday, 5:30 pm gather, 6:00 pm roll (spring and summer)
pace: Road A ~17 mph, Road B ~13 mph, social ~10 mph, MTB at Lone Lake Park
description: Four options leave the brewery at once: two road groups, a mountain bike group at Lone Lake Park, and an 11-mile social ride. All no-drop. Helmets required. Buy-one-get-one beer after.

name: RASC Monday Road Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 6:00 pm (summer)

start_location.name: Bamber Valley Elementary School
start_location.address: Bamber Valley Rd SW, Rochester, MN 55902

cost: membership required; guests may try two rides on a waiver
description: A club road ride split into four speed groups so there is a place for most riders. Meets at Bamber Valley Elementary on the southwest side. There is also a Wednesday road ride from Bicycle Sports and a Thursday gravel ride. Helmets required.

name: Big Shark West Saturday Gravel Growl
schedule: Every Saturday, 7:30 am, year-round

start_location.name: Big Shark West (next to Kaldi's Coffee)

description: A 27-mile gravel loop on the Monarch Levee Trail, the Katy Trail, Busch Greenway and the Hamburg Trail, starting and ending at the west county store. Runs all winter. Gravel, cross, mountain or hybrid bike.

name: Girl Bike Gang Monday Ride
schedule: Mondays. Time and start are posted on Instagram.
description: A Monday ride in Kansas City, Missouri for women. BikeWalkKC lists it on its Women Bike KC resources page. Time and meeting spot are on the group's Instagram.

name: KC Critical Mass
schedule: Last Friday of every month, meet ~6:30 pm, roll ~7:00 pm

start_location.name: Sunfresh in Westport, back lot off 40th & Pennsylvania

description: A monthly parade-style ride through Kansas City on the last Friday. No set route, no leaders, the slowest rider sets the pace and the group masses up when it spreads out. News and the ride calendar live on the Facebook group.

name: KC Family Bike Ride
schedule: Sunday mornings on the Trolley Track Trail. Time is posted on Instagram.
description: A Sunday morning ride for families on the Trolley Track Trail in Brookside. Kids welcome. BikeWalkKC lists it on its Women Bike KC resources page. Check Instagram for the time.

name: Women-Led Cycling Wednesday Night Ride
schedule: Wednesday nights

start_location.name: Waldo, Kansas City, MO (start posted on Instagram)

description: A Wednesday night group ride out of the Waldo neighborhood, led by women and open to everyone. Listed by BikeWalkKC's Women Bike KC program as one of the metro's inclusive ride groups. Meet point and time go up on Instagram each week.

name: Big Shark Saturday Mellow Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 7:30 am

start_location.name: Big Shark Bicycle Company, Big Bend

pace: chilled out, slightly slower than the shop's main ride
description: The mellow option on Big Shark's Saturday morning road ride from the Big Bend store. 28 miles, no-drop, and the group will shorten the route if it wants. Road bike or quick hybrid. Ride leaders show up when it's above 35 degrees.

name: Springbike Tuesday Night Ride
schedule: Tuesdays, 6:00 pm, roughly March through October

start_location.name: Bill and Payne Stewart Golf Course

description: A north side road ride from the Bill and Payne Stewart Golf Course. The route is 23 miles with about 800 feet of climbing and a rest stop in Strafford. The club also runs Monday and Wednesday night rides from Rogersville and Republic. The club's insurance requires riders to be members. The schedule on the club site was posted for 2025.

name: South Side Cycling Club Wednesday Evening Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:00 pm sharp, April 1–October 28
pace: Beginner (up to 10 mi in 1:45), party pace 12–13 mph, intermediate 14–15 mph, advanced 16+ mph

host.name: South Side Cyclery / South Side Cycling Club

description: Four pace groups leave the shop at once, from a true beginner group up to 16+ mph. Routes change weekly around the city and county. Helmets and lights required; arrive early to sign the waiver. Ride changes post on the club's Facebook and Instagram. The shop also runs a fall Saturday 8 am training ride.

name: Springbike Thursday Night Social Ride
schedule: Thursdays, 6:00 pm, roughly March through October
description: An 8-mile social ride at a slow pace on the Frisco Highline Trail. It starts at the Willard trailhead just outside Springfield. People hang around after at Mile6 Taproom. The club added it in 2025.

name: Bike Biloxi Monthly Ride
schedule: Third Tuesday of the month, 6:00 pm
description: A monthly social ride that meets at the Biloxi Visitors Center and is open to all. The regional trails group lists it as a dinner ride. Bring lights in the darker months.

name: JMC Tuesday Club Ride
schedule: Tuesdays, 6:00 pm, starting after the March time change
pace: all levels, ride your own pace
founded_note: Club operating since 1995, per the club site
description: A 22-mile out-and-back on low-traffic roads north of Jackson. The club calls it a good place to learn group riding and build confidence. All pace levels show up. Bring a chair and hang out after.

name: Hattiesburg Tuesday Night Worlds
schedule: Tuesdays, 5:30 pm

start_location.name: Jackson Road, near Jed's Perfect Endurance Bikes

description: The local fast ride. It is a drop ride at race pace. The shop asks new riders to call first.

name: Jed's Saturday Morning Ride
schedule: Saturdays, 8:00 am; exact start posted weekly on Facebook
pace: A race pace; B ~18.5 mph; C under 17 mph
description: Three groups leave from the Longleaf Trace. A is a race-pace drop ride. B stays together at around 18.5 mph. C is a no-drop group under 17 mph that rides 45 minutes out and back.

name: Soul City Cycling Monday Encouragement Ride
schedule: Mondays, 6:00 pm, starting in late March
pace: all levels, ride your own pace
description: A Monday night out-and-back of about 20 miles with 457 feet of climbing. Riders from beginner to fast all come and ride at their own pace. Bring a chair for afterward. The start point is posted in the Soul City Cycling Facebook group.

name: First Saturday Ocean Springs Community Ride (Tato-Nut)
schedule: First Saturday of the month, about 9:00 am (varies by season)

host.name: TriHard Sports and Gulf Coast Bicycle Club

description: A relaxed family ride through shaded neighborhoods, along the beachfront road and through Gulf Islands National Seashore. Any bike, any age. It follows the Live Oaks Bicycle Trail and is known locally as the Tato-Nut ride, after the donut shop. Confirm the start time with TriHard Sports.

name: Bay Night Ride
schedule: Second Saturday of the month, 5:30 pm
description: A monthly evening ride. The group meets at War Memorial Park in Pass Christian and rides together to Bay St. Louis. Check the Facebook group before going, since details came from the regional trails listing.

name: JMC Thursday Evening Ride
schedule: Thursday evenings; routes and start posted on Facebook

start_location.name: Parking lot behind Soulshine Pizza, or the office building across from Fleet Feet on Hwy 51

founded_note: Club operating since 1995, per the club site
description: Thursday road rides in Ridgeland with a few route choices. One group usually leaves from behind Soulshine Pizza and another from the office building across from Fleet Feet. Check the club or Madison/Ridgeland Cycling Facebook pages for that week's plan.

name: Saturday Core Shop Ride
schedule: Saturdays, 9:00 am
description: A 40-mile no-drop ride from the shop. The pace is quick at 20 to 22 mph average, so it suits riders who can already hold a fast group.

name: Thursday Spring Lake Ride
schedule: Thursdays, 5:30 pm
description: A 27.5-mile Thursday ride. The first 10 miles are casual, then it splits into an 18 to 20 mph group and a 22 to 24 mph group. Everyone rejoins for the last 7 miles.

name: Tuesday Night Loop
schedule: Tuesdays, 5:30 pm
description: A weeknight road loop of 25 to 30 miles. Groups range from 16 mph to 25 mph average.

name: Spoke Shop Monday Road Ride
schedule: Mondays, 6:30 pm
pace: all levels, adjusted to the group
description: Monday evening road ride from the Spoke Shop lot on Broadwater. Billings TrailNet lists it as open to all levels and adjustable to who shows up. The shop also lists a Saturday morning urban ride (12 to 16 miles) and a Wednesday mountain bike ride from Zimmerman Trail, April to early October. Confirm on the shop's Facebook page before you go.

name: Alter Cycles Tuesday Mountain Bike Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00 pm, during the dry months
founded_note: Already drawing 50+ riders by July 2018, per The Radavist
description: Meet at the shop at 6, carpool to a different trail each week, ride, then grill at the trailhead while the sun goes down. Aimed at the average trail-bike rider; pace is intermediate to advanced. Bring your own food for the BBQ. Weather dependent; the week's trail is posted on the shop's Instagram or you can call the shop that day.

name: Great Falls Bicycle Club Thursday Road Ride
schedule: Thursdays, typically 5:30 pm, April through July or later
description: The club's weekly road ride from Gibson Park. It also lists a Tuesday mountain bike ride at 6 pm from the Lewis and Clark Overlook. Bad weather or muddy trails cancel. The rides page is old, so check the club's Facebook page first.

name: Helena Bicycle Club Thursday Evening Ride
schedule: Thursdays, 6:00 pm, May through September

start_location.name: Parking lot behind Four Georgians School, on Custer Ave

description: A weekly club road ride of 15 to 20 miles. The Masonic home is a common turnaround, but the group picks the route based on wind. The club also rides Tuesday evenings at 6 pm and Wednesday mornings at 10 am from Clancy. Updates go out on the club email list.

name: Saturday Night Roll-Out
schedule: Saturdays, 5:00 pm
description: An end-of-week ride from the shop in downtown Kalispell. Moderate pace, about 20 miles, mixed surface from trail to road. A gravel or all-terrain bike works best.

name: Wednesday Night Trails
schedule: Wednesdays, 6:45 pm
description: Wheaton's Cycle's weekly trail ride at Herron Park. It is fast, with 12 to 24 miles and a lot of climbing. Bring lights. The shop lists extra rides on its Facebook page.

name: Montana Dirt Girls Tuesday Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00 pm, year-round (mountain bikes roughly April–October, hiking the rest of the year)
founded_note: The group has been around since 2001, per its website
description: A women's and female-centered outdoor meetup that mountain bikes on Tuesday evenings from spring into fall and hikes the rest of the year. Location changes each week and goes out by email and on Facebook. Casual and social. Anyone looking for a female-centered space is welcome.

name: Thursday Night Mountain Bike Group
schedule: Every Thursday, 6:00 pm; trailhead changes weekly

host.name: Missoula Thursday Night Mountain Bike Group

founded_note: Ride archives on the group's site go back to 2004
description: A long-running informal group that rides a different trail near Missoula every Thursday at 6 pm. New riders are welcome. The week's ride goes out by email list and on the group's Facebook group. Past ride maps on the site show the kind of terrain to expect.

name: Bear's Community Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday in season, gather 6:00 pm, roll 6:30 pm
description: A weekly city ride run by Asheville on Bikes. Staff support each ride and routes are posted ahead of time. Planned gather-up spots keep the group together. Good for people new to riding in traffic. E-bikes welcome. Bring a helmet, lights and water, and sign the waiver.

name: Motion Makers Women's Mountain Bike Ride
schedule: Mondays, 6:00 pm
description: A no-drop women's mountain bike ride on the Bent Creek trails. Six to eight miles of forest singletrack. The shop also runs a no-drop Saturday morning ride from the same trailhead. Confirm with the shop before driving out.

name: Magic Cycles Shop Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 5:30 pm (mid-March–September)
description: Wednesday shop ride in the High Country, listed on the Boone Area Cyclists ride page with a Strava route. Boone rides go out most weekday evenings at 5:30 from mid-March through September; this is the shop-hosted one.

name: Charlotte Bike Party
schedule: Second Friday of every month, 7:00 pm
description: A monthly ride that leaves from Birdsong Brewing. The route is flat, simple and under 10 miles. No one gets dropped. All bikes and all riders are welcome.

name: Charlotte Critical Mass
schedule: Last Friday of every month, meet 6:45 pm, roll 7:00 pm
description: The monthly Critical Mass ride in Uptown. Riders meet at First Ward Park on the last Friday. Charlotte Urbanists call it the city's largest group ride. The idea is safety in numbers.

name: Charlotte Thrives Monthly Ride
schedule: Second Sunday of every month; time and start posted on Instagram
description: A queer cycling club in Charlotte. The group describes itself as body-inclusive and gender-affirming. It rides on the second Sunday of each month. Start point and time are posted on Instagram before each ride.

name: Dirt Divas Tuesday Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 5:45 pm, spring through fall; trail changes weekly
description: Charlotte's women's mountain bike club. From spring through fall they meet every Tuesday at a different trail, split into groups by level, and ride. Beginners through experts. Check the club's social pages for that week's trail.

name: Plaza Midwood Tuesday Night Ride (PMTNR)
schedule: Every Tuesday, meet 7:45 pm, roll 8:00 pm
pace: party pace, about 10 mph, regroups every 2–3 miles
description: Charlotte's big weekly party-pace ride. It rolls rain or shine and regroups every few miles, with a stop around mile 10. Lights and a helmet are required. New riders should be able to hold about 10 mph.

name: The Spoke Easy Wednesday Urban Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 7:00 pm
description: A Wednesday night ride from the shop and bar in Elizabeth. Routes change weekly, from urban loops to trail exploring. The aim is to be back by 9 pm for a beer at the shop. The shop also runs an easy 10-mile Saturday ride at 1 pm.

name: Black Spoke Society First Tuesday Social Ride
schedule: First Tuesday of every month, 6:00 pm
description: A no-drop social ride led by Black Spoke Society. Bike Durham's ride guide lists the group as for Black and queer folks. Ride leaders, music, and snack stops when needed. Helmet required, lights encouraged. The group has run other weekly rides too, so check Instagram.

name: First Friday Ride
schedule: First Friday of every month, 7:30 pm
description: A monthly night ride from the bull statue downtown. Ten to fifteen miles at an easy pace, no-drop, ending somewhere different each time. Any bike, casual clothes.

name: Ride Around Durham (RAD)
schedule: Every Thursday, 6:30 pm
founded_note: Founded August 2021 by Duke graduate student Israel Golden, per The Duke Chronicle (Nov 2023)
description: A casual Thursday ride that gathers in front of Duke Chapel and ends somewhere different each week. Any bike works. It began with Duke students and grew into a citywide ride. Check Instagram before you go; a 2023 article had the start at 7 pm.

name: The Daily Women's+ Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 8:00 or 9:00 am depending on season
description: A Saturday road ride for women and femme-identifying riders. About 30 miles at 15–16 mph, and no one is dropped. Road bike and kit. Start time shifts between 8 and 9 am, so check Instagram.

name: TWIG Cruiser Ride
schedule: Last Sunday of every month; time varies (calendar shows about 2 pm)
description: A monthly cruiser ride for the trans, women, intersex and gender-nonconforming community. Short, slow and no-drop. Any bike, casual clothes. Check Instagram for the time.

name: Ride-A-Bike Happy Tuesday Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00 pm (listed as May through August)
description: A slow social ride through quiet Gastonia neighborhoods. It leaves from the front of the shop. The group stops as needed to stay together. Helmets required. Call the shop or check its Facebook page for updates.

name: Cycles de ORO Easy Riders Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday during Daylight Saving Time; 6:00 pm meet, 6:15 pm briefing, 6:30 pm roll
pace: slow, conversational, frequent regroups, no one left behind
description: The shop's ride for new riders and people getting back into it. Tuesday evenings from the store. The shop also runs a conversational-pace social ride every Saturday morning.

name: Cycles de ORO Saturday Social Ride
schedule: Every Saturday; arrive 9:30 am, roll 10:00 am (warm-weather schedule; skipped for local charity rides or bad weather)
pace: conversational, short distances, group stays together
description: Saturday morning social ride from the shop at a conversational pace. Start time is on the shop's site and changes with the season.

name: The Hub & Pisgah Tavern Wednesday Shop Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday; time posted in the shop's Strava club
description: No-drop Wednesday mountain bike ride into Pisgah from the shop at the forest entrance, with the tavern waiting after. Weekly time and trail are posted in the Strava club.

name: Coffee Outside Raleigh
schedule: First Friday of every month, roll out 7:30 am
description: A short morning ride from Oak City Cycling to Dix Park to make coffee outside. Bring your own brew kit or a thermos. Some riders bring gear to share. There is no wrong way to do it.

name: Crank Arm Wednesday Bike Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 7:00 pm
description: A weekly no-drop ride from the bike-themed brewery in the Warehouse District. About an hour on the bike. Lights and helmets are required.

name: Raleigh Critical Mass
schedule: Last Friday of every month, 7:00 pm
description: Billed as Raleigh's biggest group ride. It rolls at 7 pm from the NC State Belltower on Hillsborough Street. All wheels are welcome: bikes, scooters, skateboards, skates.

name: The Green Line Commuter Bike Bus
schedule: Every Wednesday, 7:30 am, April–October
pace: casual, around 12 mph, runs on a timetable
founded_note: Described on the Oaks & Spokes events page as a 2026 pilot, April–October
description: A group commute on a fixed timetable. It leaves Lockwood Park, follows the Crabtree Creek and House Creek greenways to NC State, and ends at Moore Square around 9 am. Hop on or off at any listed stop. The pace is casual but it keeps to the schedule, so it is technically a drop ride. A 2026 pilot.

name: Cargo District Thursday
schedule: Every Thursday, 6:00 pm, during the lighter months
pace: D group 14–15 mph; C group 16–18 mph if a leader shows
description: A social club ride from the Cargo District. The main leader stays with the 14–15 mph group, so it suits people new to group riding. Park on the street; the lot is small. You sign the club waiver at the start.

name: Coffee & A Roll Sunday Ride
schedule: Most Sundays, 8:00 am

start_location.name: Greenfield Lake Park, main parking lot

description: A relaxed Sunday club ride that loops through Wilmington with a coffee stop at Mayfaire. You should be comfortable shifting, braking and riding near others. Bring a spare tube. Cancelled below 38°F or on wet roads.

name: Ride Like a Fish
schedule: Every Monday, meet 6:15 pm, year-round

start_location.name: Fiddlin' Fish Brewing Co. (lot across 8th St)

description: A Monday social ride co-hosted by BeersNGears and Fiddlin' Fish. Meet in the lot across 8th Street from the brewery. Ten to twelve miles through town, then back for a pint. All paces welcome.

name: 701 Co-Ed Road Group Ride (Red Barn Route)
schedule: Every other Wednesday, 6:00 pm, summer into September
description: A road ride hosted by 701 Cycle and Sport. Riders meet at Pioneer Park at 6 pm and ride the Red Barn route. The shop's calendar showed it about every two weeks through the 2025 season. Check the shop calendar for current dates.

name: 701 Women's MTB Group Ride
schedule: Most Mondays in summer, 6:00 pm, trailhead rotates
description: A women's mountain bike ride run by 701 Cycle and Sport. The trailhead changes week to week. Past spots include Harmon Lake, Fort Lincoln, Sleepy Hollow and Pioneer Park. Check the shop calendar for the meeting point. Dates listed were from the 2025 season.

name: Great Northern Monday Riding 101 Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 6:00 pm, spring and summer
description: A ride for people who have never ridden in a group on the road. Shop guides teach hand signals, drafting and etiquette at a casual 12–16 mph. Any bike welcome. Distance grows to about 20 miles as the summer goes on. Free parking in the ramp after 5 pm.

name: Great Northern W.O.W. (Women on Wheels) Road Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, 6:00 pm, spring and summer
description: A women-only road ride from the downtown shop. 20 to 25 miles at 15–18 mph, no-drop, with the emphasis on spinning and talking. Road bike recommended, helmet required. The shop also runs a Tuesday social ride and a Wednesday fitness ride at 6 pm.

name: Ski & Bike Shop Monday Gravel Ride
schedule: Mondays, 6:00 pm

start_location.name: Ski & Bike Shop
start_location.address: 3610 S Washington St, Grand Forks, ND 58201

description: A no-drop gravel ride that starts at the shop's front door. All levels are welcome. It heads out on the gravel roads around Grand Forks.

name: Ski & Bike Shop Thursday Road Ride
schedule: Thursdays, 6:00 pm

start_location.name: Ski & Bike Shop
start_location.address: 3610 S Washington St, Grand Forks, ND 58201

description: A no-drop road ride from the shop on South Washington. New and experienced riders both show up. The shop also runs a Wednesday mountain bike ride at Lincoln Park starting in spring.

name: Tuesday Nacho Ride
schedule: Tuesday evenings, around 5:30 pm, May through September

start_location.name: MoPac East trailhead, 84th St & N Hazelwood

founded_note: Founded in 2008 by Phil Wolfe, per a Daily Nebraskan article
description: Riders take the crushed-limestone MoPac East Trail from the 84th Street trailhead in Lincoln to Eagle, about 10 miles each way. The stop is Bailey's Local in Eagle for nachos. All ages and paces show up, often a hundred or more people. You can also start from Walton or Elmwood for a different distance.

name: Omaha Pedalers Saturday Morning Easy Trail Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 9:00 am (club signature rides take priority some Saturdays)
description: An easy 20-mile spin on the Keystone Trail from Aksarben, then coffee at Roast Coffee House. The Pedalers are a social club, not a race club, and rides are open to anyone. They also run a Thursday 10 am 'Rusty Spokes' trail ride and a Thursday 5 pm taco ride to Bellevue.

name: The Bike Way / Omaha Velo Monday Shop Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 6:15 pm
description: The weekly road ride of Omaha's race club, run out of The Bike Way. Fast, 20 mph and up, with regroups; riders are expected to know the route and get themselves home. No TT bikes. There is also a Saturday 9 am no-drop ride from Roast Coffeehouse in Aksarben, May through September.

name: Tuesday Night Women's Gravel Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00 pm
description: A women's gravel ride hosted by Omaha Velo and The Bike Way, leaving from the Papio South trailhead south of Omaha. Same group runs a Saturday 8 am gravel ride from Walnut Creek.

name: Thirsty Turtle
schedule: Thursdays, 6:00 pm, March–October
description: An hour-long Thursday evening ride open to all abilities, then pizza and beer at La Festa. The shop's faster Tuesday Night Ride (19–20 mph, 30–45 miles) leaves from the same door at 5:30.

name: Sunday Morning Over Easy
schedule: Every Sunday, 10:00 am, May to October
description: An easy 10-mile community ride from Manchester's nonprofit bike shop. Kids can come with an adult. The collective also runs a Friday Evening Spin at 5:30 pm on the same terms. Sign the season waiver before your first ride. Rental bikes are available with notice.

name: Mama Wheelies Ladies Group Ride
schedule: Wednesdays, meet 5:30 pm, roll 5:45 pm
description: A weekly women's ride that meets at Papa Wheelies on Wednesday evenings and rolls at 5:45. Runs year-round. The group has its own Strava club and Instagram; email mamawheelies@gmail.com with questions.

name: Papa Wheelies Monday Night Road Ride
schedule: Mondays, 6:00 pm, April–October
description: The Seacoast's Monday night road ride, three pace groups from the shop lot. Drop-bar road bikes only. The A group goes as fast as it wants; the C group at 14–16 is the newer addition for people who want the ride without the racing.

name: Saturday No-Drop Road Ride (Sourland Cycles)
schedule: Saturdays, 9:00 am, spring through fall
description: A shop ride in the Sourland hills north of Princeton. Starts the season as a flat 15-mile beginner ride and grows from there as the leader sees fit. No drop. Helmet and lights required. The shop also runs no-drop weekday co-ed rides Mondays at 4 and Thursdays at 10.

name: Women's Wednesday Road Ride (Sourland Cycles)
schedule: Wednesday evenings, start between 5:00 and 6:00 pm, spring through fall
description: A friendly no-drop road ride for women, about 24 miles with 1,200 feet of climbing in the Sourlands. Beginners and seasoned riders both welcome. The shop also runs a women's no-drop mountain bike ride on the third Thursday of summer months.

name: Bike JC Light-Up Ride
schedule: Monthly, a Friday at 7:30 pm

start_location.name: Grove Street PATH plaza
start_location.address: Grove St & Newark Ave, Jersey City, NJ 07302

description: A monthly evening group ride from the Grove Street PATH plaza, run by Jersey City's bike advocacy group. Lights on, easy pace, all kinds of bikes. The next date is posted on bikejc.org and Instagram.

name: Friday Ladies Ride (Montclair Bikery)
schedule: Fridays, 9:00 am, April–October
pace: C pace, low to mid teens mph
description: A weekday-morning women's road ride from the shop, strictly C pace: 20 to 35 miles in the low to mid teens. Shop staff ride along. Call the shop for the WhatsApp link. Helmets required; wet roads cancel.

name: Saturday Shop Ride (Montclair Bikery)
schedule: Saturdays, 8:00 am, April–October
pace: A or B pace depending on who shows
description: A weekend road ride from the shop, A or B pace depending on the group. Routes are posted in the shop's WhatsApp chat; call the shop to get the link. Self-supported: bring your own flat kit, food and water. Helmets required. Cancelled for wet roads or freezing temps.

name: Marty's Monday Women's Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 9:30 am, spring through fall, weather permitting
description: A no-drop women's road ride from Loantaka Park. Routes run 15 to 20 miles at 12 to 14 mph. Updates go in the Team Marty's Women Facebook group. Helmet and waiver required.

name: Marty's Tuesday Evening Road Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00 pm, mid-April through September, weather permitting
pace: 17–18 mph in spring, 18–20 mph in summer
description: The shop's faster weeknight ride, for experienced riders. It is a drop ride and the route changes weekly. Marty's also runs Saturday rides from its Morristown and Randolph stores and Sunday rides from East Hanover and Morristown.

name: JSTS Weeknight Rides (Jersey Shore Touring Society)
schedule: Weeknight rides Tuesday (Michael J. Tighe Park, 5:15 pm), Wednesday (Holmdel Park, 5:00 pm) and Thursday (Brookdale Community College, 5:30 pm) as of early September 2026; start times move with sunset; many weekend rides too

start_location.name: Varies by day: Michael J. Tighe Park, Freehold (Tue); Holmdel Park (Wed); Brookdale Community College, Lincroft (Thu)

pace: A through D pace groups, listed per ride
founded_note: Club site mentions a 40th anniversary but does not state the founding year
cost: membership required for outdoor rides; free trial membership available
description: A Monmouth County club that says its focus is social, not competitive. The September calendar shows Tuesday and Wednesday evening rides of 18 to 27 miles in several pace groups, plus long weekend rides. Outdoor rides are members-only with advance sign-up; a free trial membership gets you in the door.

name: NMTS Saturday Easy Group Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 9:00 am

start_location.name: Open Space Shining River parking lot

description: A short, easy Saturday ride at around 13 mph, about 15 miles. The gentlest ride on the club's weekly list and a reasonable first group ride in Albuquerque. Helmet required.

name: NMTS Sunday Bosque Trail Ride
schedule: Every Sunday, 9:00 am

start_location.name: Open Space Shining River parking area

description: A Sunday morning road ride along the Rio Grande bosque trail from Albuquerque's touring club. About 36 miles and open to all paces. Approved helmet required. The club posts a full weekly ride list on its site.

name: Bike & Chowder Club Rides
schedule: A group Sunday, Tuesday and Thursday; B group Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday; 8:00 am start in September (check the schedule page as seasons change)
pace: A group 18–20+ mph; B group stay-together 14–18 mph
founded_note: Founded 1984, per the club's website
description: A Las Cruces recreational riding group going since 1984. No memberships, no dues, one rule: helmets. Most rides end with coffee or food. Four rides a week; times and start points are on the club's schedule page.

name: Santa Fe Road Riders Weekend Rides
schedule: Saturdays gravel, Sundays road; start rotates on a monthly pattern (in-town weeks start at Betterday Coffee)
description: A volunteer-run weekend ride group: gravel on Saturdays, road on Sundays. Starts rotate through the month between in-town coffee shops, Pojoaque and south of town. No guaranteed leader or sweep. Details and weather calls go out in a private Facebook group.

name: Santa Fe Seniors on Bikes Tuesday Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday; start time shifts by month (9:00 am in summer, 11:00 am in winter)

start_location.name: DeVargas Mall
start_location.address: 564 N Guadalupe St, Santa Fe, NM 87501

description: A social road ride for riders 50 and older, split into an energetic A group and a relaxed B group. Rides cancel automatically in freezing, hot, wet or windy weather. The club also rides Thursdays (April–October) and Saturdays.

name: Giant Las Vegas Summerlin Saturday Road Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 7:00 am (Sunday 7:00 am faster ride; Mountain's Edge store Saturday 6:30 am)

start_location.name: Giant Las Vegas – Summerlin
start_location.address: 2283 N Rampart Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89128

description: A relaxed 25-mile Saturday shop ride at 13 to 16 mph with regroups; the shop says no one is ever left behind. The Sunday ride from the same store is the fast one at 18 to 20 mph, and the Mountain's Edge store runs a 40 to 50 mile Saturday ride.

name: Giant Las Vegas Tuesday Night MTB Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 7:00 pm
pace: two groups: faster 12–15 mi and casual 8–12 mi
description: Night mountain bike ride on the Cottonwood Valley trails out of Blue Diamond. Two groups, both no-drop, about two hours. Bring lights. Call the shop (702-844-2453, option 1) with questions.

name: Pedal & Pour Sunday Coffee Ride
schedule: Every Sunday morning (Friday Loop Ride, 41 mi, for faster riders); RSVP on the shop's Strava club

start_location.name: Pedal & Pour
start_location.address: 9742 W Maule Ave, Las Vegas, NV 89148

description: A coffee shop and bike shop in one. The Sunday Coffee Ride is a relaxed 20-mile loop from the shop that ends back at the cafe. Friday's Loop Ride is 41 miles for more experienced riders. RSVP through the shop's Strava club.

name: Bike Night Reno
schedule: Every Wednesday, show up 7:45 pm, roll about 8:15 pm

start_location.name: Reno City Plaza (Believe sign / Space Whale)

description: A weekly downtown social night ride that meets at the Believe sign in City Plaza. Everyone is welcome, any bike. Routes are on the group's Strava club. Listed on the Reno Wheelmen calendar.

name: Reno Wheelmen Wednesday Group Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 5:30 pm (seasonal; waiver required once per season)
pace: B ~18 mph, C ~15 mph, faster riders self-organize
description: The club's Wednesday evening ride out to Verdi with B and C groups behind ride leaders. Groups ride out together in a double paceline at talking pace and regroup three times, but don't necessarily wait on the way back. The club notes the slower groups are not slow.

name: Sparks Group Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 10:00 am (start time may shift in summer heat)
pace: friendly, social, recreational; all experience levels
description: A friendly, social Saturday ride from a Sparks bike shop, open to all experience levels. Moved to Sierra Bicycle Supply in June 2026 so riders can grab supplies before rolling. Listed on the Reno Wheelmen calendar with weekly ride updates.

name: Beacon Bicycle Coalition Monthly Group Ride
schedule: Last Thursday of every month, 6:00 pm

start_location.name: The Dummy Light
start_location.address: Main St & East Main St, Beacon, NY 12508

description: A monthly town ride from Beacon's old dummy light. Some months it is an easy loop around town; others go farther, even across the river. All levels are welcome. The coalition works on bike culture and safer streets in Beacon and the Hudson Valley.

name: Massapequa Park Bicycle Club Rides
schedule: Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday, Sunday and holidays. 8:30 am in warmer months, 9:00 am in cooler months; some rides start earlier

start_location.name: Bethpage Public Library (most common start; others on the calendar)

founded_note: Founded 1974, per the club's site
description: A Long Island road club with midweek and weekend rides for a range of speeds. Many rides leave from the Bethpage library; others start out east or upstate. Each ride on the calendar lists pace, distance and start. The club meets the first Tuesday of the month in Plainview.

name: Dawn Patrol
schedule: Every Thursday, meet 6:45 am, roll by 7:00 am
duration: ~1 hour, five to six park laps
pace: A and B groups, double paceline
founded_note: The ride's Instagram counts collective miles since 2024
description: A Thursday morning training ride in Prospect Park for women: cis women, trans women, and non-binary people who would race in a women's field. Started by riders from the Continental Ostroy team. Five or six laps in a paceline, then coffee. You should be comfortable riding close to others in a busy park.

name: East Brooklyn Bike Club Wednesday Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 5:00 pm, early June to mid/late September

start_location.name: Citi Bike station at Zion Triangle
start_location.address: Pitkin Ave & East New York Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11212

host.name: East Brooklyn Bike Club with Citi Bike

founded_note: Citi Bike says its Weekly Rides series launched in 2023
description: A beginner ride through Brownsville and East Brooklyn, led by the East Brooklyn Bike Club. Part of Citi Bike's free Weekly Rides series, so you can use a Citi Bike at no charge. No sign-up. The posted schedule is from the 2025 season; check the club's Instagram for this year's dates.

name: NightCAP Ride (Cyclists Against Patriarchy)
schedule: Every Monday, 6:45 pm. Start point changes; posted on Instagram
founded_note: NightCAP began in Oakland in 2006 and has chapters in other cities, per Gothamist coverage surfaced in search
description: A social ride for women, trans, non-binary and queer riders. The group calls it a ride for anyone but cis dudes. The meeting spot moves around Brooklyn and is posted on Instagram each week. The ride pauses for winter.

name: Non Binary Bike Club Wednesday Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 7:00 pm

start_location.name: Fort Greene Park, just inside the Willoughby Ave / Washington Park entrance
start_location.address: Willoughby Ave & Washington Park, Brooklyn, NY 11205

description: A year-round Brooklyn bike club for non-binary riders and allies. The Wednesday ride is moderate and no-drop, and usually ends somewhere for food or drinks. Each week's destination and route go up on the club site. Bring lights, a lock, a helmet and water.

name: Queer Joyride
schedule: Every Tuesday, meet 7:00 pm, roll about 7:12 pm
description: A queer-led, queer-centered social ride through Brooklyn. Meets at Grand Army Plaza on Tuesday nights and ends at a hangout spot. Routes run around 8 miles with some hills. Bring a helmet and music.

name: Slow Roll Buffalo Monday Night Community Ride
schedule: Every Monday, mid-May through mid-October. Meet 6:00 pm, ride 6:30 pm (5:30 pm in October)
founded_note: Launched 2014, per the About Us page
description: A ten-mile guided ride from a different host neighborhood every Monday, with two regroup stops and an after-party with food and music. A volunteer SQUAD of over 100 keeps the ride together. Kids, seniors and first-timers ride. 2026 season runs May 18 to October 12.

name: Slow Spokes Tuesday Ride at Wilkeson Pointe
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00 pm
description: A relaxed Tuesday evening ride from the Outer Harbor. Slow Spokes runs a free ride somewhere in Western New York almost every weeknight; this is the Buffalo one. All skill levels, ends back at the bar.

name: OCC Tuesday Slow N' Easy Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday in summer, 6:00 pm
founded_note: Club site: cycling in Central NY since 1972
description: A beginner ride on flat, low-traffic roads west of Syracuse. Two experienced riders lead every group and nobody gets left behind. Any bike works; families with kids are welcome. A faster option leaves from the same park the same night.

name: Huntington Bicycle Club Weekend Rides
schedule: Saturdays, Sundays and holidays. 8:00 am Jun–Sep, 8:30 am in May and October, 9:00 am Dec–Apr
pace: C, C+, B and B+ groups
description: Several pace groups leave the Smith Street lot every weekend, all year. Weekday groups meet at Bethany Church and Breezy Park in Huntington Station. Ride sign-up on the club calendar is required.

name: FLCC Women's Road Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:00 pm, mid-May to mid-September

start_location.name: East Hill Plaza, parking lot behind Tompkins Community Bank

pace: A 15+ mph, B 13–15 mph, C 10–12 mph
cost: free for the first two weeks, then club membership
description: A Wednesday evening women's ride with three pace groups. It is no-drop: the group waits for flats and regroups at climbs and big intersections. The C group keeps it shorter with less climbing. Road, hybrid and gravel bikes all work. Bring lights.

name: 34th Avenue Citi Bike Weekly Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 10:00 am, early June to mid/late September

start_location.name: Citi Bike station, 34th Avenue between 93rd & 94th Streets

host.name: 34th Avenue Open Streets Coalition with Citi Bike

founded_note: Citi Bike says its Weekly Rides series launched in 2023
description: A beginner group ride led by the 34th Avenue Open Streets Coalition. You can ride a Citi Bike at no charge. No sign-up; just show up. You need to already know how to ride. The schedule on Citi Bike's page was last posted for the 2025 season, so check the coalition's Instagram before you go.

name: Slow Spokes Friday Ride in Lockport
schedule: Every Friday, 6:00 pm
description: Friday evening slow ride along the canal town of Lockport. Same format as the other Slow Spokes nights: easy pace, all bikes, a stop or two, back to the cafe.

name: Achilles + Citi Bike Adaptive Cycling (Central Park)
schedule: Tuesdays 5:00 pm and Saturdays 8:00 am, May to early November. Other sessions run weekly in Brooklyn, the Bronx and Queens
description: Free adaptive cycling sessions for people with disabilities. Handcycles and tandems are provided; you reserve one ahead of time. The same program meets at McCarren Park and Prospect Park in Brooklyn, Williamsbridge Oval in the Bronx, and Flushing Meadows in Queens. Volunteers are welcome.

name: Black Girls Do Bike NYC Weekend Rides
schedule: Weekend rides through the season, posted on Eventbrite and Facebook. New member / beginner rides are Saturdays at 10:00 am in Central Park

start_location.name: Varies. Beginner rides meet at Trek Bicycle Upper West Side (72nd St)
